exposure: COVID-19 seroprevalence (IgM/IgG positive) in pregnant women
cohort: The study included 345 pregnant women who arrived at the obstetric emergency at Hospital San Bartolome in Lima, Peru, and underwent an immunochromatography test for IgM/IgG to determine COVID-19 seroprevalence.
finding: Almost all pregnant women (nearly 100%) were asymptomatic for COVID-19, with a very low rate of respiratory complications (0.2%), and a low proportion of neonates (3.3%) tested positive for SARS-CoV-19 within the first 24 hours, although fetal deaths showed a higher incidence in July 2020.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery by cesarean section was low compared to other publications, with all cases having obstetric indication.
birth_weight: 61% of newborns weighed between 2500 and 3500 g
